commands.review_summary:
The PR changes Telegram HTML chunk planning so an empty chunk whose tag overhead exhausts the limit appends the remaining text instead of throwing, and updates the formatter regression test to expect delivered content.

PR surface: Source +3, Tests +4. Total +7 across 2 files.

Reproducibility: yes. from source inspection: current main still throws in `splitTelegramHtmlChunks` when tag overhead fills the chunk, and the linked issue plus existing test identify the same path. I did not run tests in this read-only review.

target.title: fix(telegram): deliver content instead of throwing when tag overhead fills chunk
target.body: ## What Problem This Solves Fixes #102910 — `splitTelegramHtmlChunks` throws an uncaught error when HTML tag overhead (open + close tags) fills the entire chunk limit, leaving no room for text. This causes complete message delivery failure. For example, `x` with a 10-char limit has 21 chars of tag overhead, triggering a crash instead of delivering the message. ## Why This Change Was Made In `appendText`, the `available <= 0 && !chunkHasPayload` branch previously threw an Error. The fix sets `chunkHasPayload = true`, appends the remaining text, and breaks — allowing the outer loop to close tags normally and `flushCurrent()` to produce a well-formed HTML fragment. ## User Impact **Before:** Message with nested rich formatting → silent delivery failure **After:** Message is delivered with content intact; the chunk may slightly exceed the limit, which Telegram accepts in practice ## Evidence Branch: `fix/102910-telegram-tag-overhead` | Base: `upstream/main` | Node: v22.19.0 Linux x64 ### Live proof: node --import tsx ``` Test 1 (x, limit=10): Before fix: throws Error (message lost) After fix: ["x"] Content delivered: PASS Test 2 (hello, limit=100): Normal: ["hello"] No regression: PASS Test 3 (leading entity): PASS - still throws as before (unchanged) ``` ### Regression tests ``` node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/telegram/src/format.test.ts Test Files 1 passed (1) Tests 68 passed (68) ``` ### Checks - `oxfmt` — passed - `oxlint` — passed - `git diff --check` — passed - `autoreview --engine claude` — **patch is correct (1)** ### Diff summary ``` extensions/telegram/src/format.ts | 5 ++++- (force deliver instead of throw) extensions/telegram/src/format.test.ts | 7 ++++--- (verify content delivered) ``` - [x] I understand what the code does - [x] Change is focused and does not mix unrelated concerns
